NATURE OF COMMENTS
1(a) It is our opinion that the temporary use will not have any significant effect on the recreational opportunities of the community.
disturbed by construction work or changes in grade be regraded, topsoiled, tertilized and sodded, and that your contractor post with the District the necessary insurance naming the District as insured or additional insured.
2(a) Our interest in the project is in the effect on woodland and other vegetation, and largely coincides with that of the Cook County Forest Preserve District, with whom you have been working. A few trees and shrubs in the median strip would hold the soil and also prevent distraction between eastbound and westbound traffic. Trees can also be used as a noise barrier where needed.

2(b) According to the document, most of the route will be through business and residential property. The residential property. The residential properties, at least, undoubtedly have some trees. A description of the losses of trees, resulting from the increase of the width of the right of way, would facilitate evaluation of environmental impact.
